penalties.details: CCPA vide its order dated 09.06.2026 has imposed a penalty of Rs. 1 Lakh on the Company for the use of the word 100 percent whole wheat on its bread products i.e. 100 percentage Atta Bread/ 100 percentage Whole Wheat Bread.
penalties.impact: There is no material impact on financial, operation or other activities of the listed entity. In fact the Company has filed an appeal against the order of CCPA before National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, New Delhi as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. Where Honerable Commission has granted a stay of the Impugned Order.

penalties.details: Additional District Magistrate Administration, Gautam Buddha Nagar, passed an order on 24 June 2026 in a case under Section 52 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 against Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd. and related parties. The case arose after a sample of Sliced Brown Bread collected from the company’s Greater Noida facility was tested by the National Food Laboratory, Ghaziabad, shows total protein and total fat above the label declared value, which declared the product.
penalties.impact: There is no impact on financial, operation or other activities of the listed entity. Joint penalty of Rs. 25,000 on all respondents under Section 52 is imposed by FSSAI.

timeline.summary: Anoop Bector, Promoter, and Promoter Group declared no encumbrance of Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Limited shares on March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹485.86 Cr (+8.9% YoY), net profit ₹35.41 Cr (+3.3% YoY).
Mrs. Bectors posted Q4FY26 revenue of ₹485.9 Cr (+8.9% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹61.7 Cr (+11.1% YoY), crossing ₹2,000 Cr FY26 revenue.
Atul Sud, CFO, shared the Q4 & FY26 conference call audio recording link on May 29, 2026, at 12:00 PM (IST).
Mrs. Bectors reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹485.86 Cr (+8.9% YoY) and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹2,043.6 Cr, crossing the ₹2,000 Cr milestone.
